name: Deliver the Shipment
summary: After Driftwood, Watcher Biggs has one last job for you while the wagon is being repaired. Biggs has packed up the key supplies rescued from the ogre attacks and wants you to carry them to Quartermaster Lungertz at Nethergarde Keep.

sections.title: A Last Delivery for Biggs
sections.body: While Biggs repairs the wagon, the key supplies rescued from the ogre attacks have been packed up for you to carry to Nethergarde Keep. The keep stands in the Blasted Lands' northern hills, watching over the Dark Portal. Biggs gives the route: follow the road east, head south into the Blasted Lands where it branches, and turn left at the next fork, with a warning to be wary.

sections.title: At Nethergarde
sections.body: Quartermaster Lungertz is startled to receive a package from Biggs' caravan, since the keep had given up the caravan and Biggs for lost. Lungertz thanks you and hopes the supplies hold Azoran Crystals, a much-needed reagent whose stock at the keep is running low.

faq.q: Who sends the shipment to Nethergarde?
faq.answer: Watcher Biggs, who stays to repair the wagon, packed up key supplies rescued from the ogre attacks.

faq.q: Where does this shipment need to go?
faq.answer: It goes to Quartermaster Lungertz at Nethergarde Keep, in the Blasted Lands' northern hills.

faq.q: What comes directly before this delivery?
aliases: what quest comes before deliver the shipment

faq.q: What route leads from the swamp to the keep?
faq.answer: Follow the road east, turn south into the Blasted Lands where the road branches, then take the left at the next fork.

faq.q: What is Nethergarde Keep watching over?
aliases: why is nethergarde in blasted lands
faq.answer: It keeps watch over the Dark Portal.
